search.snippet: 5 days ago · It’s a fairly direct line in the sand from Jagex, especially for Old School RuneScape, where item values and player-driven trading are a huge part of the game. The message is simple enough: if real money is being tied to the price of in-game items, Jagex doesn’t want it in the economy. Further reading: Official Old School RuneScape news
